purpose: Restore the official Krea2 QuadView four-view prompt/layout, use the local Krea2 Turbo model and QuadView LoRA, and keep the front full-body face blank while retaining faces in the close-up and side view.

prompt_template.official_quadview_prompt: Convert the character in the image to a Character Sheet showing a face close-up, front full body, side full body and back full body views.
prompt_template.shared_face_rule: Panel-specific face rule: In the leftmost first panel, the face close-up shows the normal recognizable face with eyes, eyebrows, nose, and mouth. In the second panel (front full-body view) only, the face is a smooth blank surface with no eyes, eyebrows, nose, or mouth. In the third panel (side full-body profile), show the normal visible profile face. Do not leave the face blank in the close-up or side-view panel.
prompt_template.role_feature_rule: Append only distinctive character features or signature items; do not repeat the QuadView layout instructions.
prompt_template.shared_face_rule_v1: In the front full-body view only, leave the face blank with no eyes, eyebrows, nose, or mouth. Keep normal facial features visible in the face close-up and side view.

All three face close-ups show normal facial features; all three second-panel front full-body faces are blank; all three third-panel side profiles retain visible faces.
